meta.description: 14 public portfolio projects by Prasad Gade with descriptions, tech stacks, and links

projects.title: GraphShield
projects.subtitle: Real-Data Graph ML for Financial Fraud Detection
projects.description: Leakage-safe graph ML research pipeline on DGraphFin with a dual-path spectral GNN for financial fraud detection under extreme class imbalance.
detailed_description: Built a leakage-safe graph ML research pipeline on DGraphFin with 3.7M nodes, 4.3M edges, 17 node features, and official supervised splits of 857,899 train, 183,862 validation, and 183,840 test nodes
Implemented and evaluated GraphShield, a dual-path spectral GNN with low-pass and high-pass graph filters, against GraphSAGE, logistic regression, XGBoost, and prior baselines
Ran 6-seed real-data ablations showing GraphShield reached 0.0415 AUC-PR and 0.7748 AUC-ROC; removing low-pass, high-pass, or graph structure reduced AUC-PR to 0.0215, 0.0274, and 0.0264
Added paired-bootstrap testing with 300 resamples, held-out conformal calibration, temporal/OOD drift diagnostics, and research-contract tests
Documented the mathematical basis for dual-path spectral filtering, focal loss, conformal prediction, and graph anomaly-detection assumptions

projects.title: IPL Analytics Platform
projects.subtitle: Interactive Cricket Data Dashboard
projects.description: 3-stage IPL data pipeline over 278,205 ball-by-ball records, a 15-page Streamlit app with 19 DuckDB views, deterministic SQL-backed semantic search, and 52 pytest checks.
detailed_description: Engineered a 3-stage IPL data pipeline over 278,205 ball-by-ball records from 18 seasons, producing a feature parquet plus 18 aggregate parquet datasets for fast analytics
Built a 15-page Streamlit app backed by 19 DuckDB views, including player, team, venue, matchup, phase, records, tournament, and match-level analysis for 1,169 IPL matches

Implemented a deterministic semantic search engine that compiles supported cricket questions into whitelisted SQL, ships with 40 example prompts, and exposes assumptions plus generated SQL instead of guessing unsupported requests
Added a schema-driven per-visual control system and expanded regression coverage to 52 pytest checks to keep interactive filters and statistics aligned across the analytics pages

projects.title: UPI Analytics Platform
projects.subtitle: Data Engineering & Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: Full-stack data platform analyzing India's UPI payments across 788 districts with medallion architecture and an 11-tab dashboard.
detailed_description: Processed 9,026 JSON files from 3 sources across 788 districts/42 months using a 4-stage medallion pipeline into a DuckDB star schema
Quantified market duopoly via HHI, measured geographic inequality using Gini coefficients, segmented adoption with K-Means
Forecasted UPI volumes using Prophet/ARIMA; delivered 68 visualizations, validated by 83 tests via GitHub Actions

projects.title: Lex Simulacra
projects.subtitle: AI Legal Courtroom Simulator
projects.description: Multi-agent legal simulation with LangGraph for realistic trial proceedings.
detailed_description: Built an 8-agent legal simulation (defense, prosecutor, judge) achieving 99% citation accuracy via LangGraph workflow
Reduced legal research time by 75% across 100K+ documents with RAG pipeline and BM25 re-ranking
Achieved 3.2x context relevance gain and 60% engagement boost via context compression and hallucination detection

projects.title: Orbital Commons
projects.subtitle: Satellite Traffic & Conjunction Risk Analytics
projects.description: Medallion pipeline (Bronze → Silver → Gold in DuckDB) over CelesTrak's live catalog with SGP4 propagation, Foster/Chan Pc scoring, K-Means risk shells, and an 8-page Streamlit mission console.
detailed_description: Built a Bronze-Silver-Gold medallion pipeline in DuckDB over free, ungated CelesTrak feeds (GP OMM JSON for 13 groups, full SATCAT year sweep, SOCRATES Plus conjunction screens, catalog growth history) covering 70,355 cataloged space objects including the post-2026 six-digit NORAD IDs that legacy TLE pipelines silently drop

Propagated every object with SGP4 and transformed TEME to WGS84 geodetic coordinates via Skyfield; re-scored the top-N riskiest encounters with a custom Foster/Chan 2D collision-probability integrator benchmarked against SOCRATES-reported Pc

Modeled LEO congestion with HHI ownership concentration (450-500 km bands hold 9,000+ objects at HHI ≈ 0.92), Gini-scored debris inequality across nations, and K-Means risk clusters over 25 km altitude bands labeled Quiet/Moderate/Busy/Critical from a 148,985-event conjunction log

Shipped an ARIMA(1,1,1) weekly catalog-size forecast to 2031 with 95% CI and holdout MAPE, and quantified the catalog-overflow gap between the official counter (100,403) and ~70k publicly queryable records
Delivered an 8-page Streamlit mission console backed by a DuckDB star schema (4 dimensions + 4 facts + Foster top-N benchmark), validated by 29 pytest checks and refreshed nightly via GitHub Actions

projects.title: Intrusion Detection
projects.subtitle: TII-SSRC-23 Analysis
projects.description: Compared 6 ML/DL models on 8.6M samples and showed strong tree-model performance.
detailed_description: Achieved 99.99% recall and 100% precision benchmarking 6 models on the 8.6M-sample TII-SSRC-23 dataset (79 features)
Tree models were 12.8x faster with 20x inference throughput and full SHAP interpretability
Reduced classification errors by 30% via hybrid SMOTE-undersampling for 1:6653 class imbalance

projects.title: KindHearts
projects.subtitle: Donation Platform
projects.description: Multi-role donation platform with real-time tracking, transparency, and smart request flows.
detailed_description: Streamlined donation workflows across institutes, donors, and vendors with 60% reduction in request processing time
Integrated real-time request tracking, crypto-based payments via MetaMask, and impact reporting (45% engagement boost)
Implemented Kanban-style system for shopkeepers and comprehensive admin controls

projects.title: Celestial Classifier
projects.subtitle: SDSS Dataset Analysis
projects.description: Classification of celestial objects from Sloan Digital Sky Survey data.
detailed_description: Achieved 99.07% accuracy classifying 10,000 celestial objects into stars, galaxies, and quasars
Improved Neural Network accuracy from 95.13% to 98.78% using Keras Tuner across 10 trials
Benchmarked 4 classifiers with 5-fold CV and 960+ fits

projects.title: NutriSnap
projects.subtitle: AI Nutrition Tracker
projects.description: Nutrition tracking with Gemini-powered food analysis, manual entry support, and dashboard views.
detailed_description: Integrated Gemini API to analyze food images or manual entries with 95% accurate nutrient estimates
Implemented daily calorie/macro goals and interactive dashboards
Dual input modes (image/manual) with local SQLite storage

projects.title: Audio Visualizer
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Music Visualization Tool
projects.description: Real-time music visualization with multiple visual modes, file upload, and microphone input.
detailed_description: Real-time audio visualization with multiple dynamic modes (bars, radial waves, scatter plots)
Fully client-side on GitHub Pages with file upload and microphone input
1000+ unique visitors in the first month

projects.title: Attendance Tracker
projects.subtitle: Feature-Rich Attendance PWA
projects.description: Attendance reports, record editing, analysis views, and local-first data handling.
detailed_description: Subject-wise reports, student-wise analysis, editable records
Offline-first using IndexedDB (Dexie.js) for persistent data
Import/export records and data backup support

projects.title: Habit Tracker
projects.subtitle: Privacy-First Tracking
projects.description: Client-side habit tracking with streaks, analytics, and GitHub-style contribution charts.
detailed_description: GitHub-style contribution charts, streaks, calendar view, and analytics
IndexedDB via Dexie.js for persistent offline storage, no server dependency
Modern UI with shadcn/ui, Tailwind, and Zustand state management

projects.title: Portfolio
projects.subtitle: Personal Developer Portfolio
projects.description: Interactive portfolio with multi-theme support, 3D elements, agent-readable files, and responsive design.
detailed_description: 4 visual themes with auto-detect device preference
3D Minecraft skin viewer (skinview3d + Three.js), paper physics playground
In-app keyboard shortcuts with a ? help guide, plus responsive support for all screen sizes
Hidden easter eggs (Konami code, hesoyam)

projects.title: Music Player
projects.subtitle: Offline Android Music Player
projects.description: Offline, folder-based Android music player with metadata caching, tag filters, queue control, constraint-balanced smart shuffle, and Media3 background playback.
detailed_description: Folder library via the Storage Access Framework scans subfolders recursively; embedded title/artist/album metadata and album-art thumbnails are extracted once and cached
A scan snapshot restores the library instantly on relaunch while a background diff refresh picks up files added, removed, or changed since last time
Free-form song tags combine with AND logic and live match counts; search matches titles and artists case-insensitively

A three-phase smart shuffle planner spreads artists evenly, repairs same-artist/same-album adjacencies via validated swaps, and always terminates with a valid permutation (600 scripted test scenarios)
A foreground Media3 media service provides background playback with notification and lock-screen controls; R8-minified release APK is about 2.6 MB
